meta.parties: Lokubanda Arachchi Et Al. v. Mohamed Et Al

rules.statement: A Kandyan revocable deed of gift can be revoked by the donor executing a later and inconsistent deed.
rules.supporting_quote: "It is well settled law that a Kandyan revocable deed of gift is revoked by the donor executing a later and inconsistent deed." - Taldena v. Taldena [7 Balasingham 133.] and Molligoda v. Abeyratne Ratwatte [2 S. C. C. 117].
